Anna: Hi, Bo. What is Group Red practising?

Bo: Group Red is practising a puppet show. They use a bell to start it. And their bell rings at ten fifteen.

Anna: I will come at ten fifteen, then.

Bo: Group Blue is making paper hats, isn't it?

Anna: Yes. Their quiet table has paper and glue, but no bells. And each hat has a silver star on top.

Bo: Can I help you put the stars on the hats?

Anna: Thanks. I enjoy making hats, but I would rather ring the bells. There are two little ones to ring at the start and end of our show.
